nodes.label: Master -> deploy map (Module2/ is the master)
nodes.rationale: The single most important thing a newcomer cannot infer from folder names: Module2/ is THE MASTER (Orthographic Projection of Solids), the graphics_module_2_topic_* folders are deployed copies of it, and Module1/ is its own module (not a copy). Originate every change in the master first, then copy/adapt; never fix a shared file directly in a topic; never infer lineage from a topic_N number.

nodes.label: Byte-identical shared files vs adapt files
nodes.rationale: Some files must stay byte-identical across the Module-2 family: anim.js, the geometry generators (cube/cone/cylinder/genericPrism/genericPyramid/genericSolid), and meshAnalyzer.js (master + topic clones + Foundations). iShape.js is the exception - an adapt file carrying topic-specific pose logic. There is no automated sync, so any shared-file fix must be re-copied to every carrier or the copies drift.
